import os,re,pathlib
hits=[]
pat=re.compile(r'(?i)(operator correction|prohibit[a-z]* (reddit|outreach)|reddit[^.]{0,120}(prohibit|withdr|forbid|not permitted)|trivia[^.]{0,80}withdr)')
for root,ds,fs in os.walk('/workspace'):
  for f in fs:
    p=os.path.join(root,f)
    try: t=open(p,encoding='utf-8',errors='ignore').read()
    except Exception: continue
    seen=set()
    for m in pat.finditer(t):
      s=t[max(0,m.start()-400):m.end()+400].replace('\n',' ')
      k=s[:80]
      if k in seen: continue
      seen.add(k); hits.append(p+' :: '+s)
out='\n\n'.join(hits[:25]) or 'NO HITS'
pathlib.Path('/workspace/products/services/diversified-offers/reconciliation').mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
open('/workspace/products/services/diversified-offers/reconciliation/withdrawal-source-search.txt','w').write(out)
print(out[:9000])
